The credit terms are below. How the work is deliveredToza carries out every engagement in person, at your home or office, with you present and in control of your credentials. Hardening is Toza's own method, developed from public guidance of government security agencies and security vendors. Start with an assessmentPrivate Exposure Assessment · ₪4,000Half a day in person to establish your personal threat model, assess exposure, address urgent issues and set priorities. You keep a written exposure summary whether or not you continue.How the credit worksThe ₪4,000 assessment fee counts in full toward protection whose work begins within 30 days of assessment completion. The assessment and protection are separate decisions. Larger households and ongoing careLarger households, several residences or household staff: a fixed price agreed after the assessment, from ₪90,000.After the 60 days, past clients can choose Annual Care, from ₪12,000 a year.If you authorize it, Toza coordinates with your lawyer or family office.Full scope and terms: Conditions.
